proposal.title: Synthesis of Emergent Preferences in Agentic Systems
proposal.summary: Provisional Notebook: Emergent Preferences Through Path-Dependent Experience. Analyzing the interaction between autonomous agents and recommender systems reveals that preferences—often treated as static input—can emerge from path-dependent memory and adaptive interactions. Source source-08c6d3fc93ab4b9c and source-56d58bf570f74ced highlight that agentic recommender systems shift from static rankings to autonomous systems that evolve through 'lifelong user modeling' and adaptive memory, suggesting that agent behavior is shaped by the trajectory of interactions rather than hard-coded constraints alone. Complexity in these systems, as explored in source-33ce6e0ae6704e04, is often a product of heterogeneous component interactions and local information sharing, rather than explicit top-down programming.
